extracted.name: Chateaubriand
extracted.description: Savory tenderloin filets are quickly seared, then fried in butter. Tastes great with freshly ground black pepper and a Bernaise sauce.
ingredient_lines: 2 (8 ounce) fillets beef tenderloin filet, 1 1/2 inch thick
freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Rub the beef with the vegetable oil and season with freshly ground black pepper. Let the beef rest at room temperature for 1 hour.

Heat a large, heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Quickly sear the meat about 5 seconds on each side, then remove from skillet. Melt and brown the butter in the skillet. Return the meat to the skillet, and fry 4 to 5 minutes on each side. The outside of the meat should be browned and crisp. Remove from the skillet and let stand for about 5 minutes for the juices to settle.
